title: Raman Spectroscopy: Application in Periodontal and Oral Regenerative Surgery for Bone
authors: Evaluation E. Gatin, P. Nagy, I. Paun, O. Dubok, V. Bucur, P. Windisch. IRBM, Volume 40, Issue 5, 2019, Pages 279- 285, ISSN 1959-0318.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The spectra intensity variation related to the specific bone constituents' concentrations, before and after healing, is reflecting the rate of the healing process mostly by the changes that oc curred for the calcified tissues. Moreover, the bone sample fluorescence is related to the collagen content, enabling the quantification of healing process” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
